turns.instruction:
Analyze a continuous beam in the global X-Z plane using OpenSees. Supports are at x=0, 5 and 10 m; the beam continues to the free tip at x=12 m. The left support is a pin and the other two are bilateral vertical rollers. All support rotations about Y remain free; all beam joints are continuous. Use material M1 and section B1 throughout, exactly as supplied in the public attachments. Load case D has 8 kN/m downward (global -Z) over the entire 12 m, including the overhang, and a separate 10 kN downward nodal force at the free tip x=12 m. Perform first-order linear static Euler-Bernoulli analysis with self-weight disabled. Report D: all three vertical support reactions and all horizontal support reactions; signed uz at the two supported-span midpoints x=2.5 and 7.5 m and at the free tip; and signed local M2 at the x=10 m support section on both sides. Identify locations, selection and units in the narrative and structured results.

Execute OpenSees; complete every output in input.md and check equilibrium. Clarify essential gaps or conflicts first.
